faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.faq_1_question: What does the ticket price include?
faq.faq_1_answer: The ticket price includes drinking water, blankets, pillows, and basic amenities on the bus. Other additional costs will be announced separately.
faq.faq_2_question: Can I choose my seat in advance?
faq.faq_2_answer: You can choose your seat during the online booking process. The system will hold the seat for a maximum of 15 minutes during payment.
faq.faq_3_question: What is the policy for canceling or changing tickets?
faq.faq_3_answer: Contact the call center 12 hours before departure to be assisted with canceling or changing tickets according to the specific regulations of each route.

hours.note: Call center operates on holidays. Average response time: 5 minutes.

faq_items.question: How can I check my booking status?
faq_items.answer: Log in to your King Express Bus account, go to Account > My Bookings to see ticket details and status. You can also check via the confirmation email sent to you.

faq_items.question: What are the support hours for the call center?
faq_items.answer: The call center supports customers from 07:00 to 22:00 every day, including weekends and holidays. Outside working hours, you can message us via Zalo or Facebook.

faq_items.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faq_items.answer: You can contact the call center 12 hours before departure to get advice on changing your schedule or canceling your ticket. Cancellation fees may apply depending on timing.

faq_items.question: What payment methods are supported?
faq_items.answer: We support bank transfer, e-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay), and direct payment at the bus operator office.

contact.map_desc: Find directions to our main office

faq.q1: How can I check my booking status?
faq.a1: Log in to your King Express Bus account, go to Account > My Bookings to see ticket details and status.
faq.q2: What are the support hours for the call center?
faq.a2: The call center supports customers from 07:00 to 22:00 every day, including weekends and holidays.
faq.q3: Can I change my departure schedule?
faq.a3: You can contact the call center 12 hours before departure to get advice on changing your schedule or canceling your ticket according to regulations.

position.title: Position & Milestones
position.paragraph1: With over 7 years of establishment and development, King Express Bus has built its position as a high-quality passenger transport operator trusted by many customers.
position.paragraph2: From the first trips conquering the Hanoi ⇄ Sapa mountain pass route, King Express Bus has now left its mark on Vietnam's tourism map, expanding connections to famous destinations like Ninh Binh, Hue, and Da Nang.
position.paragraph3: We not only provide transportation services but also deliver comprehensive mobility solutions where customers are at the center of every experience.

fleet.title: High-Quality Fleet System
fleet.description: Understanding that comfort is a key factor, King Express Bus continuously invests in and upgrades its fleet. We operate modern Limousine Cabin and sleeper buses for different long-distance travel needs.
fleet.highlight: With private space, comfortable interiors, and essential amenities, passengers can rest more easily throughout the journey.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: King Express Bus aims to develop as a high-quality tourism transport brand in Vietnam, focusing on safety, professionalism, and reliable service on every journey.

with_customers.title: With Customers
with_customers.content: Creating happy journeys. We commit to "Elevating experience on every mile" with absolute safety and heartfelt service attitude.

with_society.title: With Society
with_society.content: Contributing to national tourism development by connecting scenic spots with high-quality, safe, and friendly transportation services.

core_values.title: Core Values
core_values.description: The strength of King Express Bus lies in our people. Our drivers are rigorously selected, skilled in handling situations, and always adhere to the principle "Safety is life". Additionally, our enthusiastic consultants are ready to assist passengers 24/7.
